title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: Find whether the areas of periodic outer-billiard polygons can be related to the spectrum of a differential operator.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200017 (AMR-051-0017). CC BY 4.0.
M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Serge Tabachnikov, Problem 5, pp. 12--13.
